title: Projects view — scroll fade and headings

steps.path: Projects → Conversations, a long list scrolled down
steps.headline: Lists fade at their edges instead of being cut off — keep?
steps.changed: When a tab's list scrolls, the cards now fade out under the tab row and at the bottom of the window (the same see-through fade as popups and the sessions menu). Before, they were cut off in a hard line. It's on all three tabs.
steps.notice: The After picture also shows the new heading from the next step. The fade only appears at an edge where there's more to scroll.

steps.path: Projects → Files, then Conversations, then Instructions & Memories (stacked top to bottom)
steps.headline: Which heading style for the three tabs?

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Files has a small "Project Files" line, Conversations has no heading, and Instructions & Memories has small labels with a sentence squeezed beside each one.

variants.label: A · Large headings
variants.summary: Every tab opens with the same heading row, using the guide's Large heading for big groups on a full screen (like Marketplace and Library): "Project files" (with the folder path when you're inside one), "Recent conversations", and "Project instructions" / "Global instructions" each with a one-line description under it. Tools (grid/list switch, ⓘ) sit at the right of the row.

variants.label: B · Small labels
variants.summary: The same rows and words as A, but as the small grey labels popups use. Quieter, but on a full screen they're the same size as the text inside the cards.

steps.notice: Both new versions also give the Instructions & Memories file cards the same card look as the conversation cards. The only new words are "Recent conversations".
